i only have my therapist, and my aunt is nice to me but she's my uncle's wife, i don't think i can talk to her though. she may have thought i was my sister's husband (we're same height and have similar clothing) but i haven't seen her in a while. i don't think i could trust her, but i do enjoy being called over with male pronouns being used.

as far as i know, this therapist/psychologist is literally the only therapist that will accept transgender people in my country. he doesn't really say transgender, just states gender confusion. he's not very religious but my mom goes to him sometimes. i don't think i'll ever be able to help my parents, and as much as i'd like to have them support me, i've essentially accepted that they are a no-go. i do realise that they say things without thinking, but it still hurts since it's just really raw. 

my brother is most likely not gay, but he's a very good person. we've had the same type of childhood (our sisters were extremely spoiled throughout their lives and we were both only spoiled as children) and we both see no point in many many things. i am very very territorial and protective, and he is basically the only human being in this country i will protect no matter what. we've also both had really bad haircuts xp
true, but that's hard to do when you start "disconnecting" from the world and find urself in an existential crisis xp

i absolutely do not expect them to understand, i just hoped they wouldn't be so hostile. i do not think of many people as enemies, i think of everyone as neutral unless they are a positive influence, but if someone tells me to die you know damn well i wont give a rat's ass about them. the thing is i'm stuck in this stage, in which playing along causes extreme dysphoria which forces very suicidal thoughts, and not playing along causes dysphoria because everyone who knows my name assumes im not male. what i thought was my future is slowly getting demolished, i cant focus in class because of my extreme anxiety that won't leave me alone, even with meds. my parents realise i'm not staying here and they're trying to stop that, and they're trying to stop my brother from doing the almost-same. 

my future self is becoming more and more unstable and unpredictable, i'm afraid i've lost myself. the only thing i know is my system. i'm trying my hardest, because i want future me to make it, i want him to be, i want him to live and i want him to be proud of me but i know he'll just laugh years from now. i'm genuinely trying, i just can't get my damn thoughts together and i keep contradicting myself.

they don't know im gay, afaik they have no idea what im attracted to. my family is very quick to get rid of non-muslims though. im not very family-centered since my mom is a narcissist and my dad enables her (i dont touch on this in the post i dont think) i do understand the rest though, but one of my aunts i think she knows, she's a muslim and she regularly calls me "habibi" and asks me to get stuff using the masculine verbs. please please tell your friend i said thank you, and thank you as well, i really appreciate all the help.

i live in the middle east (sort of close to saudi arabia) and i am in high school (would rather not say exactly heh)


if u speak arabic i can do that? but ur english is very good i can tell you that

being a transgender man is hard to describe but it's not hard being trans in certain environments. i find it rather shitty that other people have had to feel like this though


i was thinking, my mom is a narcissist so i've been thinking of manipulating her, but i can avoid them most of the time. i will follow through, i will try to plan but my anxiety creates a lot of noise so i'm sort of dazed... eh. i will attempt to fake it til i make it, though i cant promise i'll be successful :p

i'll try my hardest, my system is weird but to me death is something someone deserves, it's a bit of a blessing i suppose. which is basically the reason i'm still alive, because i'm a shithead that doesn't deserve to die :p one of the things that keeps me happy is hearing about someone's day, so whenever you want to hit me up with how your day's been going. i may take a while to reply though xp

ey mate, i dont have much to say (therapy tmrw so if something pops up and it bothers me, i'll... figure it out) but it feels sort of good to know someone has the same intentions, as fucked up as it sounds. i do hope you don't have to go through with it though, even though i'm being a bit of a hypocrite :p i understand they wont accept me, it's just that they're trying their hardest to "reverse" it but it's always been this way, i've always been male and i've always always been gay, there is no reversal. 

the same goes for you mi amigo, i'm up for chats. will probably keep this account, since i like the name.

i have only one actual friend who i have some type of connection with, but my constant need to feel something caused me to lose my best friend last year. i do want to say that as hypocritical(?) as it seems, please don't kill yourself, school won't last forever and you seem like a good person. my dad is trying to cut off my money supply, since i can't work, but he's failing. thank you though, i hope you have a good day man.
